target: obs_no_events_hint — an empty log on an ENABLED producer must not tell the operator to enable the flag they already enabled; a genuinely disabled one still must
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic/observability; unset AGENTIC_OBSERVE; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; ON="$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" cost 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)"; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":false}}' > .agentic/config.json; OFF="$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" cost 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)"; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; HARDOFF="$(AGENTIC_OBSERVE=0 "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe_metrics.sh" cost 2>&1 >/dev/null || true)"; jq -n --arg on "$ON" --arg off "$OFF" --arg hardoff "$HARDOFF" '{on_says_enable: ($on|test("enable observability first")), on_says_idle: ($on|test("no events yet")), off_says_enable: ($off|test("enable observability first")), hardoff_says_enable: ($hardoff|test("enable observability first"))}'
